description: integrations.sh is a public registry of developer integration surfaces across many services, cataloging APIs, GraphQL endpoints, MCP servers, and CLIs. It helps users and agents discover what programmatic interfaces a domain exposes and how those interfaces authenticate.
summary: integrations.sh exposes a public REST API at `https://integrations.sh/api` and a public streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://integrations.sh/mcp`; no developer credentials were documented for either surface.
